tasks.title: Academic Discussion
tasks.instruction:
Your professor is teaching a class. Write a post responding to the professor's question.
In your response, you should do the following:
• Express and support your personal opinion.
• Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Achebe
professor.text: Social media platforms often use algorithms, which are sets of rules computers follow to make decisions, to show users content they might like or find interesting. This customization means everyone's experience is unique, but it also raises concerns. Some argue it helps users find what they enjoy faster, while others worry it might limit exposure to diverse perspectives and create echo chambers. What do you think? Does the customization of social media through algorithms have negative effects?

posts.name: Kelly
posts.text: I believe overreliance on algorithms can negatively affect our online experiences. It limits the joy of stumbling upon new content randomly. This organic discovery often leads to learning about diverse topics and viewpoints, which algorithms might filter out, creating a narrow view of the world.

posts.name: Andrew
posts.text: Personalization algorithms on social media are beneficial, especially for small creators. They help these groups gain visibility among users who have shown interest in similar content. This customization enables users to discover new content they're likely to enjoy, supporting smaller creators who might otherwise be overlooked.
